name: Halcyon Video
tagline: Jellyfin as a 90s 3D first-person VHS rental store
description: halcyon-video turns your Jellyfin media library into a navigable 3D first-person VHS rental store straight out of the 90s. Built with three.js, it lets you walk through a virtual video store and browse your self-hosted library as physical tapes. It adds character through clerk Doom-style A* pathing and a cloth-sim shopping bag, turning media browsing into a full immersive experience. A playful but technically ambitious take on the self-hosted media frontend.
highlights: Walks your Jellyfin library as a 3D first-person VHS rental store
three.js rendering with clerk Doom-style A* character pathing
Cloth-sim shopping bag adds a tactile touch
A memorable, immersive frontend for self-hosted media
curatorNote: Self-hosted media frontends are usually utilitarian lists. Converting Jellyfin into a walkable 90s video store is a genuinely creative re-frame that still solves a real browsing problem.
